column1: # Gene map of the human mitochondrial genome, revised Cambridge Reference
# Applies to any reference whose mito contig is 16,569 bp: hg38 chrM and
# GRCh37/hs37d5 MT both are. UCSC hg19's chrM is NOT rCRS (it is NC_001807,
# 16,571 bp), so plot_mito_circos.R checks contig length before using this
# file and simply omits the ideogram ring if it does not match.
